title: antirrhinum majus subsp. glutinosum
intro: Antirrhinum majus subsp. glutinosum, commonly known as sticky snapdragon, is a plant species in the plantain family (Plantaginaceae). This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from respiratory issues, such as colds and coughs, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Antirrhinum majus subsp. glutinosum are attributed to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to ease congestion and reduce swelling. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and iridoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
